item.title:
Cheeseburger Shawarma
INGREDIENTS AND RECIPE 8 pre shaped beef burgers 8 thin slices of onion 8 slices of American cheese 1/4 cup steak seasoning
For the sauce 1 cup mayonnaise 1/4 cup ketchup 1 tbsp mustard 2 tbsp BBQ sauce 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp smoked paprika 2 tbsp pickle juice Pinch of salt and pepper
For serving Lavash bread Dill pickle chips

item.title: Ice Cream Croissant Bread Pudding
item.description: A rich, comforting dessert that layers buttery croissants into a creamy bread pudding, finished with ice cream for an indulgent, easy-to-love treat.
